node.title: Assembly compiler (verdicts + refusal rule)
node.statement: The exact integer compiler maps row plus upper/lower packets to SAFE/UNSAFE/CONDITIONAL/UNKNOWN per agreement cell and emits a prize-facing radius only from a unique proved adjacent unsafe/safe pair. It refuses open axes, conjectural ledgers, absent or ambiguous adjacency, and contradictory or nonmonotone proved packets. [MASTER IMPORT 2026-07-12: refusal behavior verified by a 13-case adversarial battery beyond the node's own audit — open required axis, extra conjectural axis, conditional ledger, contradictory packets, monotonicity violations, threshold-grazing, type smuggling, axis aliasing — 13/13 correct refusals/errors.]
